notes.title: Update 1.6.0 - Balance changes
notes.content:
[h3]Blocks no longer reset when starting a new run[/h3]
[i]Now starting a new run doesn't reset blocks to zero, letting you accumulate blocks through multiple runs. This change should reduce overall difficulty and make getting stuck less likely.[/i]

[h3]Upgrade changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tree #3: removed Restraint (+15% Patience). Replaced with Champion (+2x Bossbreak)
[*] Tree #6: removed Midas (+150 pickup radius). Replaced with Supernova (+1 Flash)
[*] Changed Accumulation to only apply to new blocks earned during a run (due to the block reset change)
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made tweaks to account for the above changes. These tweaks have no effect on difficulty
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5.0 - Settings
notes.content:
[h3]Settings window[/h3]
Added a settings window with the following new features:
[list]
[*] Changing background color
[*] Changing damage number visibility
[*] Changing master/sound/music volume
[*] Toggling anti-aliasing for gameplay
[*] Centering the window when in windowed mode
[/list]
[h3]Damage numbers[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed to show all damage numbers by default
[*] Changed visuals to outlined text
[*] Large performance improvement to reduce lag spikes in high spawn waves
[/list]
[h3]Multi-monitor fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed not launching on the main monitor
[*] Added saving which monitor the game was on
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Window mode setting is now saved
[*] Delayed showing the game window on launch to reduce flickers and flashes
[*] Changed anti-aliasing to be off by default
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4.0 - Tree 4 redesign
notes.content:
[h3]Tree 4 redesign[/h3]
- Redesigned tree #4 to make it less punishing. Removed Optimization upgrade

[i]Players with tree #4 unlocked will have the tree reset after updating since major changes were made. Upgrade progress will remain[/i]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
- Added sound feedback when first clearing a boss

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
- Fixed Freedom upgrade not applying if Tinker upgrade is taken
- Fixed game clear window title overlapping with close button

notes.title: Update 1.3.0 - UI changes
notes.content:
[h3]Upgrade window re-designed[/h3]
- Can now see the whole tree without having to scroll
- Added a sidebar to select trees without changing views. Removed previous folders view

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
- Upgrade window now opens automatically after a run ends, or by early exiting from a button in the top-left. Removed Upgrade desktop button
- Lab upgrades are now viewable from the Upgrade window title bar when unlocked. Removed Lab desktop button
- Added a tutorial tooltip in the first few minutes of gameplay

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
- Fixed permanent upgrades (such as Lab) not being unlocked immediately after taking the upgrade

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - Reset change
notes.content:
[h3]Change[/h3]
- [b]Reset[/b] button now keeps your progress in that tree. If you buy 3 upgrades resetting will now give you 3 free upgrades.

[h3]Notes[/h3]
[i]Now when you're stuck you don't have to farm to get back to where you were. The previous design was overly punishing, especially since it's hard to predict which upgrades work well and which don't.[/i]
